def greedy(w,k=10):
    D=dico(w);names=list(D);sel=[]
    for _ in range(k):
        bestn=None;bestr=1e9
        for n in names:
            if n in sel: continue
            M=np.c_[tuple([D[m] for m in sel+[n]])]
            c=np.linalg.lstsq(M,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
            r=np.mean((dv_dt-M@c)**2)/np.var(dv_dt)
            if r<bestr: bestr=r;bestn=n

def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]

    return p[0] + p[1]*C + p[2]*S + p[3]*v + p[4]*np.exp(-v) + p[5]*S/v + p[6]*v*S + p[7]*t*C + p[8]*t
